headline: Bitwarden renames Collections to 'shared folders' and lets Premium and Families send any vault item by link
tldr: Bitwarden's pricing page now says "shared folders" and "shared vault" instead of collections and organizations, and Send now covers "Text, files, and vault items" on Premium and Families.
who: Bitwarden Premium and Families users, and anyone comparing password managers

redline.before: Unlimited sharing Unlimited collections Organization storage
redline.after: Unlimited sharing Unlimited shared folders Organization storage
redline.label: Pricing · Families plan
redline.note: Same feature, new name: Bitwarden says shared folders work the same as collections did.

redline.label: Pricing · Bitwarden Send, Premium and Families
redline.note: Send, which shares with anyone, even non-users, now covers whole vault items, not just text and files.

redline.before: Create an Organization and invite users for secure sharing.
redline.after: Create a shared vault and invite users for secure sharing.
redline.label: Pricing · Sharing vault items with other users

actions: If your notes, scripts or onboarding docs say "collections" or "organization vault", update them to "shared folders" and "shared vault".
Before sharing a password by Send link, set an expiration and view limit and require email verification for the recipient.
what:
Bitwarden's pricing page changed its sharing vocabulary. The Families plan now lists "Unlimited shared folders" where it said "Unlimited collections", and the sharing row now reads "Create a shared vault and invite users for secure sharing." instead of "Create an Organization and invite users for secure sharing." The Bitwarden Send row ("Transmit data securely to anyone, even non-users, with end-to-end encryption.") now lists "Text, files, and vault items" for both Premium and Families, where it said "Text and files".

What it replaces: Bitwarden's November 19, 2026 design update says "collections are now shared folders, and the organization vault is now referred to as the shared vault", and that shared folders work the same as before. Its November 2026 business update describes the new item sharing: a vault item can be shared with anyone through a link built on Bitwarden Send, end-to-end encrypted, with timed deletion and view limits, and requiring email verification of recipients.

What stays the same: Premium is still $1.65 a month billed annually at $19.80, Families $3.99 a month for up to 6 users billed annually at $47.88. The new apps roll out gradually to cloud users over the next few weeks; self-hosted users get them in a future server release.
sources: Bitwarden: A fresh look for Bitwarden (Nov 19, 2026)
Bitwarden: November 2026 product update for Business plans
